message: TUBAL HUB homepage refresh: fully branded hero, softer premium visual design, live Quick Stats, and improved real-time presence.

changelog.title: TUBAL HUB Homepage
changelog.desc: The homepage hero is now fully branded as TUBAL HUB with the official TUBAL HUB logo.

changelog.title: Softer Hero Design
changelog.desc: The bright green hero was replaced with a darker premium palette that is easier on the eyes.

changelog.title: Live Stats
changelog.desc: Quick Stats now shows live site data, including fresh Firebase presence and real content counts.

changelog.title: Real Online Presence
changelog.desc: Online users are counted from fresh Firebase presence heartbeats instead of stale online records.

changelog.title: Update Notifications
changelog.desc: The website update notifier now has a new release version so the latest changes can surface in the update notification.
